alex_support: Customer (acme-inc) opened a ticket — their Embeddings usage chart in Console is showing ~120k units for a 3h window but our API logs show ~60k vectors. They say the chart label is 'vectors' but numbers look like tokens, seems doubled. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/abcd :warning:

jon_metrics: Thanks. Can you paste org id + exact timeframe and a sample request_id?

alex_support: org=acme-inc, window=2026-03-12T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-12T03:00:00Z. Sample request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e. Customer provided a CSV of counts vs our /v1/usage logs.

jon_metrics: Running a quick rollup query against analytics to compare raw events vs dashboard aggregates.

jon_metrics: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT request_id, event_timestamp, unit_type, sum(unit_count) as raw_sum
FROM metrics.events
WHERE org = 'acme-inc' AND event_timestamp >= '2026-03-12' AND event_timestamp < '2026-03-13'
GROUP BY request_id, event_timestamp, unit_type
ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

jon_metrics: For request_id=req_0a1b2c3d4e I see two events emitted with the same request_id but different unit_type: one with unit_type='vector' count=10 and one with unit_type='token' count=6800. Dashboard rollup is summing both, which explains the ~2x discrepancy in many cases.

tara_dataops: Noted. I pulled the Kafka topic (metrics-ingest) around 02:55-03:10 and I can reproduce duplicate messages where the same payload has both tags attached after the enrichment step. Looks like the enrichment service appended unit_type twice for some older clients.

mike_sre: Any recent deploys that touched enrichment? metrics-bot: metrics-pipeline/enrichment v2.4.9 deployed by ci-bot at 2026-03-12T02:58:11Z (canary) and full rollout at 2026-03-12T03:06:05Z.

tara_dataops: That matches. The v2.4.9 change merged a fallback that sets unit_type based on model heuristics, but it didn't check if unit_type was already present. For older clients that already emit token-level counts we end up with both.

jon_metrics: Proposed short-term fix: change dashboard rollup to dedupe by request_id and prefer explicit unit_type if present. Example patch to aggregation SQL:
```sql
SELECT request_id,
       CASE WHEN max(has_unit_type_explicit) = 1 THEN max(unit_type) ELSE 'vector' END as unit_type,
       sum(unit_count) as unit_sum
FROM (
  SELECT request_id, unit_type, unit_count, (unit_source = 'client')::int as has_unit_type_explicit
  FROM metrics.events
  WHERE ...
) sub
GROUP BY request_id;
```

tara_dataops: I ran a local backfill dedup for acme-inc using request_id dedupe and results match the API logs (raw vectors). Backfill reduced dashboard totals from 121,432 -> 60,714 for that window.

mike_sre: Rolling the aggregation change to prod now (will gate via canary). Keeping enrichment rollback as standby. :white_check_mark:

alex_support: I'll update the customer with the interim explanation and tell them we expect numbers to match after the backfill and aggregation fix.

alex_support: Repro steps for eng/customer support to validate: 1) Make an embeddings request that returns N vectors. 2) Capture request_id from API response. 3) Query analytics.events for that request_id and check if there are multiple unit_type entries. 4) Confirm Console chart matches the deduped query.

jon_metrics: Added a regression alert to the dashboard: if sum(dashboard.units) / sum(api.reported_vectors) > 1.2 for any org over 1h then page #oncall-metrics.

tara_dataops: Follow-up: will patch enrichment to skip adding unit_type if unit_type already present, and add unit provenance tag. Deploy planned in 2 hours.

alex_support: Customer told me they're paused on billing until we confirm. I'll post update when backfill completes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
